description: This file contains API functions for fetching project-specific financial data such as cost and cost history sum from a backend server. It includes functions getProjectCost and getProjectCostHistorySum, which make HTTP GET requests and process the responses.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost and currency data for a specified project from the backend API.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total project cost aggregated from session tracking cost deltas, considering granular deltas for accuracy.
